title: Drifter Desserts Strawberry Donut 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Donut by Drifter Desserts blends the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberry with the soft, comforting taste of a freshly baked Donut. The bright fruit notes are lifted by a rich, doughy base, creating a flavour that balances sweet berry freshness with indulgent bakery depth. This Nic Salt e-liquid uses a 50VG/50PG ratio, delivering clear flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, it performs best with low-powered pod vapes, starter kits, and refillable vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it caters to a range of nicotine needs. Drifter Desserts is part of the UK-made Drifter collection from Juice Sauz, a brand recognised for creating authentic, dessert-inspired flavours crafted with quality ingredients. Pair this e-liquid with your refillable vapes or vape starter kits for effortless vaping.
